notes: «يحدثه أبو عثمان» repeats «أبي عثمان النهدي» in succession: one man, written once in the fuller form (rule 7)
«أبيه» is the father of Mu'tamir, named only by relation (relation)
«قال سمعت أبا تميمة» makes Abu Tamima a link (rule 5); the Companion «أسامة بن زيد» is the last link; «رضى الله عنهما» is an honorific
